artworks.title: Lecteur du moniteur
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The illustration depicts five individuals gathered in a room. Four men and one woman are visible from the waist up. The men sit in two rows facing the woman, who is seated on a grand couch. The woman is holding a print piece, potentially reading aloud. Her hair is styled in an updo, and she wears a detailed dress. The men have various hairstyles, with most sporting short hair and wearing dark suits. The background includes ornate details like a framed portrait and a lamp on a mantelpiece, suggesting the setting is an elegant parlor or drawing room.

artworks.title: Un directeur de n'importe quel theatre
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a man standing with his legs slightly apart. His body is angled towards an open door to his left, while his head is turned to the right. The man has a distinct profile with a prominent nose and hair on the top of his head. His facial expression is stern. He is wearing a suit jacket, a cravat, and pale trousers. His left arm is extended towards the door frame. The room has a patterned floor. The crowd outside is wearing top hats. At the doorway, a decorative railing is visible. There are no visible signs of jewelry or objects being held by the man. The image is rendered in a sketchy, monochrome style with shading conveying depth and texture.

artworks.title: Une visite aux bains
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowded public bath scene. The image shows a long line of individuals wearing top hats and suits on a wooden platform next to a pool filled with heads above the water. The scene depicts a busy bathing environment with expressive poses and faces, using strong linear elements for depth. The style resembles Honoré Daumier, known for social and political caricatures.

artworks.title: Tiens papa! ... un singe! ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a man and a child standing together. The man is holding the child's hand. Both are wearing hats and long coats. The man has distinctive facial features and is carrying additional garments. The background shows a pool with people swimming or sitting beside it.

artworks.title: Parisien commencant a regretter ... la chasse au lion ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a black-and-white illustration of a hunter surrounded by three lions. The hunter is depicted kneeling with a gun, looking startled. The lions are drawn in a caricature-like style. The drawing has dynamic diagonal lines and the caption highlights the humor of the situation, suggesting regret over going lion hunting in a lively place.

artworks.title: Si le chasseur a froiD ... le lièvre n'a pas froid ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a hunting scene with a rabbit and two hunters in a snowy landscape. The rabbit is running across the snow, one hunter looks cold and is tucking his hands into his coat, while the other hunter has an arm raised in the background. The title is "Émotions de Chasse" (translated as "Emotions of Hunting"), and the caption reads "If the hunter has cold hands... the rabbit does not have cold feet."

artworks.title: De l'utilité d'une famille pour une cantatrice
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of several individuals in an audience seated and facing a stage. The figures are depicted in profile and appear to be watching a performance. One man is leaning forward, while others seem engaged in conversation. Their faces are shown in profile with minimal detail. They are dressed formally and some are holding bouquets of flowers. On stage, a woman in a long dress is standing with clasped hands. The background depicts a crowded theater with generic silhouettes of audience members. The setting is indoors, with a draped curtain framing the stage.

artworks.title: On dit qu'on commence déja a la voir ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows three elderly women in a dimly lit room. The woman on the left stands with her hands together, while the two women on the right face each other, one holding a candle in a candlestick. All three women have aged skin, wear headscarves, long dresses or skirts, and shawls. They are gathered around a small table with a lit candle, casting their shadows on the wall. The background is dark, with the candle providing the main source of light.

artworks.title: Décidément, ce qui, cette année, obtient ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people standing in a line, looking at something on the ground. Most of them are older men in long coats and tall hats, along with one woman wearing a bonnet and a dress. They have indistinct facial features and varying poses. Most of the men are holding canes. The woman has curly hair peeking out from her bonnet and is dressed in a flowing gown with ruffled details. They are indoors, with classical-style nude sculptures in the background and a black swan and a smaller bird on the floor in front of them.

artworks.title: La dernière semaine avant l'ouverture du salon ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three painters working on a large painting. The image shows three individuals holding palettes and brushes, working on a canvas in an artist's studio. The scene includes partially rendered figures and background on the canvas they are painting. The three painters appear focused and engaged in their work. The drawing uses strong lines and shading to suggest depth and form in an illustrative style.

artworks.title: Le nouvel étendard des blanchisseuses
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of large, layered skirts being paraded down a street. A character wearing a pointed hat is observing from a balcony. The scene takes place in a stylized urban environment, with loose, impressionistic representations of buildings in the background. Below, two voluminous skirts are being carried in a lively procession that dominates the foreground. In the midground, additional figures are holding up objects and participating in the parade. The use of line work suggests movement, with the exaggerated flounce of the skirts adding a whimsical tone to the scene.

artworks.title: Mon vieux, ta peinture manque de chaleur ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two people in an outdoor winter setting. The first person is seated on a stool with a three-legged base, painting a canvas on an easel. They have long hair, wear a hat, coat, and gloves. The second person stands behind them, leaning on a staff and wearing a hat, coat, and a pack or basket on their back. The background is a wintry landscape with snowy hills, barren trees, and sparse snow on the ground.

artworks.title: Il me semble que nous allons dèrailler ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three people sitting in a train carriage. The scene depicts three individuals in conversation. On the left, a woman appears anxious, clutching her hands to her chest and leaning away from the others. In the middle, a man is animated, gesturing with his hands. On the right, another man, sitting more relaxed with a cane, engages in the conversation. The expressions and body language suggest a contrast between the anxiety of the woman and the nonchalance or humor of the men. The caption and title are in French. Lines and shading effectively bring out the characters' emotions and the confined space of the train compartment.

artworks.title: Les bourgeois ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a butcher's shop. The scene is depicted with strong contrasts of light and shadow. One figure is holding onto a hanging piece of meat while wearing an apron. The other figure appears to be engaged in conversation. The environment includes hanging cuts of meat around them.

artworks.title: J'en aurais fait un boucher ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals portrayed from head to toe. On the left is a young figure with arms crossed, wearing a round hat, loose clothing, and shoes. On the right is a tall, muscular man with crossed arms, facial features including a pronounced brow and cheekbone, and an apron over his clothing. The background shows hanging pieces of meat, and the scene is rendered in a sketchy, monochrome style.

artworks.title: Aspect de la rue Lacépède ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures moving through a street. The scene shows three individuals in 19th-century attire, each holding a weapon. The figures appear engaged in a hunt or chase. Their faces express determination and a touch of comedic exaggeration. The background includes an audience of curious faces peering over a balcony, and an inset illustration in the upper right shows two additional figures with surprised expressions. The composition emphasizes movement and intent through bold, energetic lines typical of caricature art.

artworks.title: Voyons Mr. le Baron ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a theatre. The stage shows two figures in front of an audience. One figure is on the left side, gesturing with a pleading expression while the other figure, positioned on stage, wears a costume hinting at a period or theatrical attire. Candelabras illuminate the stage, aligning parallel to the figures. The backdrop features an audience, drawn with loose pencil strokes. The atmosphere conveys drama and humor, typical of a theatrical performance, with an interaction between the figures hinting at a comedic element based on their poses and expressions.

artworks.title: Dites-donc Baptiste ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical scene with two figures watching from backstage. Two characters are dressed in theatrical costumes and are actively performing on stage with grand gestures, while two other figures are peering from behind a curtain, one hunched over the other.

artworks.title: Le terrible régisseur
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theatrical scene. The image depicts a man and a woman engaging in a conversation inside a theater setting. The woman stands on the left, wearing a long dress and a hat with floral decoration. She has one hand raised to her cheek. The man on the right is dressed in formal attire, with his arms crossed. He is labeled "LE TERRIBLE RÉGISSEUR" ("The Terrible Director"). The background includes architectural details suggesting a stage or backstage area. The drawing features detailed line work capturing the tension and drama of the scene.

artworks.title: Le mère de la débutante
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of two women shown from a mid-body perspective. On the left, the first woman is positioned facing slightly upward with clasped hands, wearing a bonnet and layered clothing. On the right, the second woman leans forward, gesturing towards a crowd, with her facial features obscured. The background shows a bustling theater setting with a large audience in gallery seats and caricatured angels above the crowd.

artworks.title: Eh bien, mon cher, vous avez perdu ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Two men are depicted from the waist up in the image. They are both wearing formal robes, suggesting a professional setting, possibly as legal professionals. The man on the left has a smug expression with a wide smile and eyes looking downward. He has curly hair peeking out from beneath a rectangular hat. The man on the right is angled towards the left, appearing to lean in to converse with the other man, with his mouth slightly open. He has a defined nose and curly hair under a similar hat. Both are wearing dark robes with a light-colored collar. The man on the left is holding eyeglasses and rolled papers in his right hand. The background features shaded patterns, creating a neutral backdrop for the two figures.

artworks.title: Seul moyen de faire avec sécurité
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: Two men are seated across from each other in what appears to be a train carriage. The man on the left wears a tall top hat and a formal suit, while the other man wears a bowler hat. Both are dressed in formal attire and hold pistols on their laps. The setting is a vintage train interior with vertical padding on the walls and a window to the right.

artworks.title: Soyez donc pas dégouté comme ca ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures in a wine-making setting. Two of the figures are stomping grapes in a large wooden vat, while another figure observes them. The figures inside the vat have exaggerated forms and expressive faces. Baskets of grapes are around the scene. The drawing is done in a cartoonish style, with expressive line work and shading. There is a caption in French below the scene.

artworks.title: Dire qu'il y a des gens qui boivent de l'absinthe ...
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows two men depicted from the waist up. The man on the left is facing slightly towards the other man, with his mouth open, while the man on the right is turned towards the first man, holding a bottle and gesturing with his other hand. Both men have distinct facial features with prominent noses and cheekbones, and they have short, curly hair. The man on the left is wearing a vest over a shirt and holds a glass. The man on the right is also dressed similarly, wearing a vest over a creased shirt, holding a bottle. The background is plain with indistinct shading, suggesting an interior setting.
